props.name: actionsRef
props.description: A ref to imperative actions. - `unmount`: Manually unmounts the menu. Call this after any externally controlled closing animation finishes. - `close`: When specified, the menu can be closed imperatively.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the popover. This can be a regular React node or a render function that receives the `payload` of the active trigger.

props.name: closeParentOnEsc
props.description: When in a submenu, determines whether pressing the Escape key closes the entire menu, or only the current child menu.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the menu is initially open. To render a controlled menu, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger that the popover is associated with. This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open popover.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: handle
props.description: A handle to associate the menu with a trigger. If specified, allows external triggers to control the menu's open state.

props.name: highlightItemOnHover
props.description: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them. Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: modal
props.description: Determines if the menu enters a modal state when open. - `true`: user interaction is limited to the menu: document page scroll is locked and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled. - `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the menu is opened or closed.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the menu is closed.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is currently open.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The visual orientation of the menu. Controls whether roving focus uses up/down or left/right arrow keys.

props.name: triggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger that the popover is associated with. This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled popover. There's no need to specify this prop when the popover is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long to wait before closing the menu that was opened on hover. Specified in milliseconds. Requires the `openOnHover` prop.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long to wait before the menu may be opened on hover. Specified in milliseconds. Requires the `openOnHover` prop.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: handle
props.description: A handle to associate the trigger with a menu.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Whether the menu should also open when the trigger is hovered.

props.name: payload
